name: Beam Camp
description_short: A sleepaway camp in the woods of Strafford, NH, run by Brooklyn's Beam Center. Campers aged 9–17 build a large group project, pick small-group activities called Domains, and work on their own projects in metal, wood, textile and digital fabrication shops. They also swim and play sports every day.
activities: Domains (rotating arts, science, performance, athletic activities)
Athletics and active play (Gaga Ball, Circle Rules Football)
refund_policy_summary: Cancel more than 3 months before camp starts and you get the deposit and tuition back in full. Cancel between 3 months and 2 months before, and you lose the deposit but get back the tuition you paid, minus any credit card fees. Cancel within 2 months of the start, and nothing is refunded. The deposit is 25% of total cost, due when you register ($100 for Pay What You Can families, refundable on request).
swim_waterfront_notes: The page says every camper can swim each day. It also lists Long Distance Swimming as a past Domain. It doesn't describe the waterfront or how swimming is supervised.

warnings: Filled zip 03884: Strafford has one ZIP code (2020 Census)
The phone, email and footer address (60 Sackett Street, Brooklyn, NY 11231) are for the Beam Center head office, not the camp site in NH.
The age rule for the 4-week session is unclear: '11 years old (OR rising 5th graders)'. A rising 5th grader is usually about 10, so younger campers may qualify.
Typo in the second listing of the 2-week session: '9 years of to 15 years old'. The first listing says 9 to 15.

The full costs shown are top-tier prices. Families may pay less under Tiered Tuition. Paying by credit card adds a 3.5% fee. Paying in full within 15 days of admission gets a 2% discount, until March 1, 2027.
Installment payments are due Jan 1, Feb 15 and Apr 1. All balances are due by April 1.
